name: Seminar Wargames (U.S. War Colleges / NDU)
description: Facilitated strategic-level wargames conducted at U.S. War Colleges (Army, Naval, Air, Marine Corps) and the National Defense University. The unstructured seminar format allows participants to explore both complex emergent strategic dynamics and chaotic discontinuities in great power competition, gray zone conflict, and crisis escalation scenarios. No fixed rules; outcomes are adjudicated by experienced facilitators.
reputation: core pedagogical method at all five U.S. war colleges; consistently cited as essential for senior leader development in joint professional military education (JPME)
notes: Format varies by institution; common variants include political-military games, crisis simulations, and red team exercises. Heavily influenced by the Newport seminar wargaming tradition dating to the 1880s. Often classified or FOUO; publicly described in open literature.

institutions: Marine Corps University (Marine Corps War College)
